fields.Name: T67 - Entity Form Field Sections Navigation
fields.Description: Verifies a record form renders its multi-section structure + section controls.

InputDefinition.goal: Open a record's full form (open an entity via the sidebar 'Search entities...' box -> click a row -> 'Open Full Record'). Verify the form's multi-section structure renders: the 'Details' field section is shown, a section-control toolbar is present near the top (icons to collapse/expand sections and/or a 'Search sections...' box), and scrolling DOWN reveals additional section headers (related-record sections). Confirming the form renders its Details section plus the section controls and further section headers is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A record full form is displayed with a 'Details' section
A section-control toolbar (collapse/expand icons and/or a 'Search sections...' box) is present and additional section headers are visible on scroll
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
